readout.purpose: Exactly one element in the app: the Home TODAY kcal master readout. Live tint #f2ede2, idle ink-faint '----'.

title.purpose: voice-title 550/1.25rem for screen titles; voice-item 500/1.125rem for entity names. Tokenized as classes; views never set raw sizes.

body.purpose: The spoken voice: sentences and instructions, usually ink-dim. Never carries numbers.

data.purpose: The measured voice: every value, unit, timestamp, provenance line. Always tabular-nums.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono micro-label that self-labels every module, key, and nav item.

voice-display.purpose: The stamp voice — earned-win banners only.

voice-item.purpose: Entity names: products, insight titles, state headings.

voice-micro.purpose: Unit captions and fine print under data values.

data-xl.purpose: Screen hero value — one per screen.

data-md.purpose: Row values and the log voice.

data-micro.purpose: Axis endpoints and engraved unit suffixes.

shadows.name: key-ledge
shadows.purpose: The single shadow in the system: the machined lower edge of the orange action key. Collapses to 0 with translateY(2px) on :active. Structural pressed-key device; never used off keys.

motion.name: led-sweep
motion.value: opacity 0->1, 90ms ease-out per cell, 40ms stagger left-to-right
motion.purpose: Success LEDs light in sequence on genuine completion (scan resolving, reward stamp).

motion.name: stamp-in
motion.purpose: The reward stamp lands like a press. Crisp exponential ease-out, never springy.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Both authored moments are disabled entirely under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: shell-max
breakpoints.purpose: max-w-md single-column console shell; the world is mobile-first with a centered column on wider viewports.

components.name: Module
components.description: A seam-bordered instrument plate that self-labels with a silkscreen micro-label and sets data in the mono voice.
components.css: .ds-module { background: var(--color-plate, #141517); border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #26282c); border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px 20px 20px; } .ds-silkscreen { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-faint, #7a7e84); margin: 0; font-weight: 400; } .ds-data { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink, #eeeff0); font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 10px 0 0; } .ds-data-faint { color: var(--color-ink-faint, #7a7e84); } .ds-data-unit { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--color-ink-dim, #a2a5aa); }

components.name: Action Key
components.description: The primary console key: solid signal orange, black mono caption, machined lower edge that collapses when pressed.
components.css: .ds-key-action { display: block; width: 100%; background: var(--color-action, #ff4d00); color: #000; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 0 #a33200; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 60ms ease-out, box-shadow 60ms ease-out; } .ds-key-action:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 #a33200; } .ds-key-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-action, #ff4d00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Key
components.description: A default console key: raised plate, seam border, silkscreen caption; depresses and brightens on press.
components.css: .ds-key { display: block; width: 100%; background: var(--color-plate-raised, #1a1c1f); color: var(--color-ink-dim, #a2a5aa); border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #26282c); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-out, transform 60ms ease-out; } .ds-key:hover { border-color: var(--color-seam-strong, #33363b); } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(1px); filter: brightness(1.15); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-action, #ff4d00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Band Chip
components.description: Qualitative band indicator: solid signal fill with black text (GOOD/LOW/HIGH), or seam-strong border with NO DATA when unknown.
components.html: GOOD LOW HIGH NO DATA
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-chip-good { background: var(--color-good, #2fd05e); color: #000; } .ds-chip-low { background: var(--color-low, #ffb020); color: #000; } .ds-chip-high { background: var(--color-high, #ff3b30); color: #000; } .ds-chip-unknown { border-color: var(--color-seam-strong, #33363b); color: var(--color-ink-faint, #7a7e84); }

components.name: Input Well
components.description: A recessed data-entry well: plate-well fill, seam border, mono text; the border turns signal orange on focus, no glow.
components.html: <label class="ds-silkscreen-label" for="ds-qty">Unit</label><input id="ds-qty" class="ds-input" value="1 UNIT">
components.css: .ds-silkscreen-label { display: block; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-faint, #7a7e84); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--color-plate-well, #101113); color: var(--color-ink, #eeeff0); border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #26282c); border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-action, #ff4d00); }

components.name: Bottom Control Strip
components.description: The five-key navigation strip on a seam-topped chassis plate; the orange SCAN key is taller and raised above the row.
components.html: HomePantryScanEatHealth
components.css: .ds-navstrip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: end; padding: 12px; background: rgba(10, 11, 12, 0.95); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #26282c); } .ds-nav-key { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 56px; background: var(--color-plate-raised, #1a1c1f); border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #26282c); border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 60ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-key:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-nav-label { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-faint, #7a7e84); } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--color-ink, #eeeff0); } .ds-nav-scan { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; height: 68px; margin-top: -12px; background: var(--color-action, #ff4d00); color: #000; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 0 #a33200; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 60ms ease-out, box-shadow 60ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-scan:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-nav-label-scan { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: LED Streak Row
components.description: Sequencer-style LED cells: lit orange for logged days, unlit wells for gaps. Success variants sweep left to right.
components.css: .ds-ledrow { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-led { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-plate-well, #101113); border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #26282c); } .ds-led-on { background: var(--color-action, #ff4d00); border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Meter
components.description: A 3px macro meter: seam track, ink-faint fill by default, a band signal color only when the band is known and meaningful.
components.css: .ds-meter { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-seam, #26282c); overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter > span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-ink-faint, #7a7e84); }

components.name: Reward Stamp
components.description: The earned-success moment: a full green field with black check and declaration, stamping in with an LED sweep. Fires only on genuine completion.

components.css: .ds-stamp { background: var(--color-good, #2fd05e); color: #000; border-radius: 6px; padding: 28px 24px 16px; animation: ds-stamp-in 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-stamp-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-stamp-text { font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; } .ds-stamp-leds { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 24px; } .ds-stamp-leds > span { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: #000; opacity: 0.25; animation: ds-led 90ms ease-out both; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 40ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 80ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 120ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 160ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 200ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 240ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 280ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 320ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(10) { animation-delay: 360ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(11) { animation-delay: 400ms; } .ds-stamp-leds > span:nth-child(12) { animation-delay: 440ms; } @keyframes ds-stamp-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.06); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } } @keyframes ds-led { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 0.25; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stamp, .ds-stamp-leds > span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Jabba's app surface is a piece of dark tabletop hardware, not a wellness feed. Every screen is a matte near-black chassis carrying seam-separated module plates; every module silkscreens its own uppercase mono micro-label in the top-left, the way a synthesizer labels a knob. Numbers are instrument readings — tabular mono everywhere, and one seven-segment master readout for the day's kilocalories. Color is functional signal, never mood: five fixed-meaning lamps on an otherwise achromatic machine.

The console is the user's, not the brand's: the status bar carries the user's name, and the machine reports only what it actually measured. When the machine doesn't know, it says so — '----', 'NO DATA', an unlit LED, an empty meter track — never a fabricated zero. When the user genuinely completes the loop, the reward fires as hardware: a full green field, an LED sweep, a stamped check, counters that tick. Nothing celebratory happens without a real trigger.

This is one committed dark world. There is no light mode and no appearance toggle; html.dark is hard-set and the browser chrome (selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring) is tuned to the console.
keyCharacteristics: Matte near-black chassis; plates separated by 1px hairline seams; no ambient shadows.
Every module self-labels with a silkscreen mono micro-label.
If it's measured, it's mono; if it's spoken, it's grotesk.
Five fixed-meaning signal colors on small areas; the machine is otherwise achromatic.
Honest unknowns: '----' / 'NO DATA' / empty tracks, never invented zeros.
Rewards are hardware events (green field, LED sweep, stamp, ticking counters), earned only.

rules.name: The Fixed-Meaning Rule
rules.body: The five signals carry fixed semantics (action, good, low, high, info) on small areas only. A signal color is never decorative, never a background wash, and never re-assigned. The single exception is the earned success stamp's full green field.

rules.name: The Black-on-Signal Rule
rules.body: Text and glyphs sitting on any signal fill are pure black (#000). Signals are lamps; lamps don't carry grey type.

rules.name: The One-Fill Band Grammar
rules.body: Qualitative band chips share one grammar: solid signal fill + black text (GOOD/OK → green, OK at 70% opacity; LOW → amber; HIGH → red). Unknown bands get no fill — seam-strong border, ink-faint text, label 'NO DATA'.

rules.name: The Measured/Spoken Rule
rules.body: If it's measured, it's mono; if it's spoken, it's grotesk. No number ever renders in Archivo; no sentence ever renders in Fragment Mono.

rules.name: The One Readout Rule
rules.body: DSEG7 appears exactly once in the app: the Home kcal master readout. A second seven-segment element anywhere devalues the gauge.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Separation is always a 1px seam or a tonal step, never a drop shadow, glow, or blur (backdrop-blur on the chassis bars is the sole blur, and it blurs content, not edges).

rules.name: The Crisp Motion Rule
rules.body: All motion is short (60–160ms base) exponential ease-out — never springy, bouncy, or looping. The LED sweep and the stamp are the only authored moments; both die under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Honest Blank Rule
rules.body: An unknown value renders as '----' (or '—', an unlit LED, an empty seam-colored track) in ink-faint. The machine never draws a zero, a guessed bar, or a placeholder number for data it doesn't hold.

dos: Do open every module with a silkscreen micro-label (Fragment Mono 11px, 0.14em, uppercase, ink-faint) at top-left; modules self-identify.
Do set every measured value in Fragment Mono with tabular-nums, with units small and ink-dim beside the number, and provenance in an 11px uppercase mono line.
Do separate with 1px seams and tonal steps (well/plate/raised); keep the 12px module rhythm.
Do put black type on any signal fill, and keep signal areas small — a chip, an LED, a marker line, a key.
Do render unknowns as '----' / 'NO DATA' / unlit cells, and quantize charts into cell stacks and tick scales.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for every authored animation.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glows, or gradients; the only shadow is the action key's machined ledge, and it stays on keys.
Don't use signal colors decoratively, as washes, or with shifted meanings; the only large signal field is the earned green success stamp.
Don't fire reward grammar (green field, LED sweep, stamp, ticking counters) without a genuine success trigger, and never use confetti or springy easing.
Don't set a number in Archivo or a sentence in Fragment Mono, and never use DSEG7 outside the single Home kcal readout.
Don't introduce a light mode, an appearance toggle, or pill radii (>6px corners); the world is one committed dark console.
Don't use icon fonts or filled glyph icons; icons are inline stroked SVGs in currentColor.
